content: Apple's canonical Transaction.updates observer sample (developer.apple.com/documentation/storekit/transaction/updates) guards 'case .verified(let transaction)' and for unverified results simply returns without calling finish() — 'Ignore unverified transactions.' Leaving unfinished means StoreKit redelivers; finishing an unverified consumable permanently destroys the only redeliverable proof of purchase (v1.1 WR-04).
